scripts.build:front: rm -rf build && cd ../front && INLINE_RUNTIME_CHUNK=false npm run build && mv -f build ../back/build
scripts.build:hfront: rm -rf hbuild && cd ../hfront && INLINE_RUNTIME_CHUNK=false npm run build && mv -f build ../back/hbuild
scripts.deploy:full: npm run build:front && npm run build:hfront && git add . && git commit -m deploying && npm run deploy
